title: Startup Profiles, DEX Layout, and Release Verification Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies startup profiles, dex layout, and release verification?
options: Keep startup rules focused, consume them through optimised release tooling and verify actual DEX-layout benefit.
Assume same purpose as Baseline Profiles
questions.answer: Keep startup rules focused, consume them through optimised release tooling and verify actual DEX-layout benefit.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Startup Profiles primarily instruct ART which methods to JIT compile after installation.
questions.explanation: Including long post-launch navigation in Startup Profile generation can dilute DEX layout focus and push critical startup code beyond the preferred primary DEX set.

questions.prompt: What distinct optimisation does a Startup Profile drive?
questions.answer: Build-time DEX layout of startup code, while Baseline Profiles guide install-time ART precompilation.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
